evals.name: pnpm Monorepo Workspace Filtering & Command Execution
evals.prompt: Configure a multi-package monorepo using pnpm-workspace.yaml, add dependencies with workspace:* protocol, and run build across filtered packages.
evals.expected_output: Defines pnpm-workspace.yaml with package globs, links internal packages with workspace:*, and demonstrates pnpm --filter commands.
assertions: Defines pnpm-workspace.yaml declaring apps/* and packages/* packages
Uses workspace:* or workspace:^ protocol for internal dependencies
Executes targeted build scripts using pnpm --filter syntax
Runs recursive scripts topologically with pnpm -r

evals.name: Prohibition of npm/yarn & Lockfile Hygiene Enforcement
evals.prompt: Audit a repository containing stray package-lock.json and yarn.lock files, map forbidden npm commands to pnpm, and enforce single lockfile hygiene.
evals.expected_output: Identifies and prunes stray lockfiles, maps npm install to pnpm install, and commits exclusively pnpm-lock.yaml.
assertions: Identifies and deletes stray package-lock.json and yarn.lock files
Enforces single authoritative pnpm-lock.yaml in version control
Maps npm i / yarn add commands to pnpm add
Replaces npx CLI execution with pnpm dlx or pnpm exec

evals.name: CI/CD Frozen Lockfile & Corepack Engine Verification
evals.prompt: Configure root package.json with Corepack packageManager pinning and write a CI/CD build script enforcing frozen lockfiles.
evals.expected_output: Pins packageManager: pnpm@... in package.json and configures CI pipeline with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
assertions: Pins exact pnpm version in package.json via packageManager field
Configures CI/CD install script using pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
Enables Corepack via corepack enable in automated environments
Prevents unexpected lockfile mutations during build execution
